items.title: A singular genus 0 proper curve with H^0(X, O_X) = k is P^1 over a nontrivial finite extension glued to Spec k at one rational point
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file curves.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs the explicit gluing diagram of a singular rational curve (statement lines 2221-2243). The proof (lines 2245-2330) turns the normalization sequence into a dimension statement through the conductor ideal: the bound dim H^0(X, A) <= n-1 from commutative subalgebras of End_k(V), the descent I = nu_*I', the combined estimate <= 2n-2, and the divisibility of dim H^0(X', A') by n = [k':k] which together force the conductor to be the ideal of a single rational point on each side. H3: the conductor bookkeeping and the divisibility pinch are a genuine argument, not a reference chase; the conclusion identifies the isomorphism type and the gluing data simultaneously.
